assets.prompt:
Create a production BACKGROUND ONLY for StarFormer 2D orthographic side-view platformer, based on the approved woodland concept reference. Extract/reimagine ONLY its distant forest scenery into a complete uninterrupted landscape backdrop. Remove ALL foreground earth/rock platforms, walls, hanging rectangular ceiling blocks, grass-topped playable surfaces, pool, water, flag, spike, ball, yellow star, text, UI. The result is NOT a game screenshot and contains NO gameplay objects and NO ground horizon that could look walkable.
Canvas 16:9 wide landscape, ideally 2048x1152. Mid-value muted sage/teal sky, stylized large rounded forest tree canopies and trunks only along extreme left and right margins, soft distant woodland layers from lower half down to bottom, small desaturated grey-sage clouds confined to top 15%. The upper-left area between x=10%-30%, y=15%-50% is a calm open mid-value sage sky with almost no detail, reserved for dark tutorial writing. The central upper area also spacious. Bottom quarter soft broad silhouettes without crisp foreground leaves. Forest continues to bottom edge without a solid ground ledge.
Maintain the approved art language: broad flat-color shapes, simple restrained two-tone shading, no photographic texture or grain, no glowing particles, no decorative arcs, no sun disks, no yellow or orange flowers, no purple plants. Mid-value palette with compressed contrast: sage sky around #789B8E, rear trees #6C9589 and #648C81, nearer backdrop trees #53786D. No dark nearly-black foreground tree trunks, no pale white sky. Background details subordinate to bright yellow star and purple ball that will be composited in engine. Crisp illustration, not painterly blur. Opaque background. This image will be behind real separate gameplay terrain, so it must contain ZERO floating platforms or apparent terrain silhouettes.
